$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$script='D:\upmix\tools\run_spectral_context_fit.ps1'
if((Get-FileHash $script -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne '040f474960c6bdf40f5843b2aa64ddcbfe18b30145d25809a7fca22b46e1f3b4'){throw 'Runner hash changed'}
$wrapper=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'upmix_spectral_context_wrapper_v1.ps1'
$live=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'upmix_spectral_context_live_v1.log'
if((Test-Path $wrapper) -or (Test-Path $live)){throw 'Preserve previous launch'}
$body="`$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; & '$script' *>&1 | Out-File -FilePath '$live' -Encoding utf8"
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($wrapper,$body)
$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$wrapper) -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
Write-Output "SPECTRAL_SUPERVISOR_PID $($p.Id)"
Write-Output "SPECTRAL_LIVE_LOG $live"
